title: Shader uniforms and post presets as GSAP tween targets
intent: Shader states on the house clock
summary: Uniform `{ value }` objects and post-look values as GSAP tween targets through one `retarget()` (`killTweensOf` first, then `to` from the current value): charge `.9 s power2.out`, release `.45 s power2.in`, so a half-finished hover turns around without a jump; `calm` / `charged` vignette, grain and density tweened together `.9 s power2.inOut`; renders only on a dirty frame from `gsap.ticker`; colour-only charge under reduced motion, instant in the static tier
variants: a plain preset proxy tweened, copied into uniforms in onUpdate (postprocessing effect properties)
colour uniforms: tween the THREE.Color's r / g / b
